question: You mentioned that Reinhard would get angry at the same sort of things a normal person would, but can you give an example of something he’d be angry about? Also, how would he show his anger? I just can’t picture Reinhard getting angry.
answer: Well, if you were to wreck a sandcastle that he’d put a lot of effort into… nah, he wouldn’t get angry at that. Hmmm, say, if you were to take the last one of his favorite food that he’d been saving, he… wouldn’t get angry either. He’d be mad if Krillin died. (Note: Krillin is a Dragonball reference)
